phrases.name: groove-step
phrases.description: Step-touch with a bounce on every count: right on 1 to 4, back on 5 to 8, forearms punching.

phrases.name: kick-ball-change
phrases.description: Bounce on 1 and 2, then a kick-ball-change: right kicks on 3, steps back on the and, weight on 4; the left does the same on 6, and on 7; the back foot steps in on the and before 5 and 8.

phrases.name: plie-roll
phrases.description: Step out wide on 2, sink into a deep plie on 3 with the arms swept overhead on 4, two body rolls rising on 5-6 and 6-7, step back in on 8.

phrases.name: turn-travel
phrases.description: Step forward on the right on 2 and pivot a quarter turn to the left by 3, travel along on 3-and-4 and 4-and-5, step the left in on 6 and pivot back to the front by 7, close on 8 with a punch.
